candidate.title: FRISCR
candidate.scope: The FRISCR (Fixed and Recovered Intact Single Cell RNA) row of the supplied Illumina single-cell poster: fixed whole-cell selection and RNA recovery followed by the depicted SmartSeq2-associated cDNA and Nextera XT-associated indexed-library route, as clarified by Thomsen et al. The separately labelled snRNA-Seq and partial SPLiT-seq rows are adjacent catalogue entries, not alternative FRISCR branches. SmartSeq2 is a downstream component here, not an additional target method. This extracts the shown fixed-cell route, not the paper’s live-cell validation controls or bulk-RNA protocols.

operations.label: Isolate RNA
operations.description: Separates RNA from the reverse-crosslinked lysate. The primary paper resolves the retained material as polyadenylated mRNA captured with oligo-dT25 magnetic beads and then eluted off the beads.
operations.mechanism: Oligo-dT/poly(A) hybridization provides the selective capture interface; elution yields soluble mRNA for cDNA preparation.

method_scopes.rationale: All nine operations belong to the single FRISCR row. The paper explicitly identifies FRISCR as recovery of RNA from fixed, permeabilized, stained and sorted single cells and couples it to SmartSeq2 cDNA and Nextera XT libraries. It clarifies the RNA-capture and pre-sort interfaces without turning omitted substeps into additional depicted operations. The diagram’s left Fixed single cell/polyA RNA drawing is an analyte key; the connected workflow starts at Cell suspension and Fix. The separate snRNA-Seq route uses nuclei and the partial SPLiT-seq route uses split-pool barcoding; neither is an explicitly offered alternative to the FRISCR row.
